title: cislunar-custody: Custody horizons for ground-based angles-only tracking of cislunar periodic orbits
description:
Python code, data and manuscript for a study of how long an object on a cislunar periodic orbit can go unobserved before it leaves a ground-based telescope search pattern centred on the operator's own prediction (the custody horizon).

Contents: Earth–Moon CR3BP orbit catalogue (L1/L2 halo, 9:2 NRHO, Lyapunov, DRO); ground optical sensor and visibility model (four sites, Moon exclusion, Krisciunas–Schaefer moonlight, photometry); Cramér–Rao bounds and consider covariance (site biases, clock offsets, solar-pressure errors); EKF, UKF, Gaussian-mixture UKF and particle filters; linear, unscented and Monte Carlo gap propagation; a family sweep over 30 orbit members; a JPL DE440 ephemeris + solar radiation pressure cross-check; 59 unit tests, scripts that regenerate every figure, and a script that checks every number in the manuscript against the data.

Release v1.1.0 corresponds to the manuscript submitted to The Journal of the Astronautical Sciences.
